text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT TENDERS - Jordan is seeking around $21 million worth of U.S. wheat, about 120,000 tonnes, financed under the PL480 programme, traders said. Offers must be received by Thursday and the result would be announced on the same day.
- Pakistan is likely to tender this week for 330,000 tonnes of soft white wheat for May-June delivery, a trade source in Islamabad said last Friday.

WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka's Co-operative Wholesale Establishment seeks 100,000 tonnes of hard wheat in 50,000-tonne lots, government officials said. Tenders close on May 16 with the first shipment for May 22-June 5 if from the U.S., Canada, Europe or Argentina, and June 10-19 from Australia or Saudi Arabia. The second shipment was for June 16-25 if from U.S., Canada, the Continent or Argentina, and June 30-July 9 from Australia or Saudi Arabia.
- South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd jointly invited tenders to buy 21,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by Wednesday for June 5-July 5 shipment.
CORN TENDER - The Commodity Credit Corp of the USDA said it would tender May 1 for up to 50,000 tonnes of U.S. corn for donation to North Korea. The corn is for May 10-30 shipment.
SOYBEAN TENDER - CCC was to tender April 30 for up to 10,000 tonnes of U.S. yellow soybeans for export to Ukraine, for May 10-June 5 shipment.

SOYMEAL TENDER - El Salvador passed on its tender for 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of PL-480 soybean meal for May 7-22 shipment, a spokesman for the PL-480 operations division, U.S. Department of Agriculture, said.
The tender was slated for April 28.
RICE TENDER - Jordan seeks to buy 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice for delivery in June, traders said. The closing date for offers is May 21.

BARLEY TENDER - Turkey's state grain board was still assessing the bids at a tender to sell 100,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley, TMO officials said. The result might be announced before noon on Wednesday.

COMMODITY TENDERS - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) seeks to buy 50,000 tonnes of tapioca hard pellet at 11:00 a.m. local time (0200 GMT) Friday for June-September arrival, an NLCF official said. It also invites tenders to buy 30,000 tonnes of wheat bran pellet or rice bran pellet on the same day for July 10 and September 10 arrival. If NLCF passes in whole or part due to high prices, it will re-invite the tenders on May 6.

- The CCC will tender April 29 for pinto beans, sunflower oil, bulgur and wheat-soy blend for donation to Moldova. It seeks 255 tonnes of pinto beans, 605 tonnes of sunflower oil, 510 tonnes of bulgur (cracked wheat), and 255 tonnes of a wheat-soy blend. The beans, bulgur and wheat-soy blend were for June 6-20 shipment and the oil was for June 20-July 5.

MARKET TALK - China may be willing to pay a premium for more soybeans from the United States because of need and availability of shipment, U.S. analysts and exporters said. "It's feasible. Chinese crushers need prompt shipment of soybeans. One cargo of U.S. soybeans was definitely shipped, but we have no confirmation of additional business," a U.S. oilseed and grain analyst with an international firm said.

... India allocated 1.28 million tonnes of rice and 973,000 tonnes of wheat for sale in May through its public rationing system. The government had allocated 1.29 million tonnes of rice and 971,000 tonnes of wheat for sale in April.

... Taiwan soybean buyers confirmed on Tuesday that two Taiwan-bound shipments would be from the United States because supplier Continental Grain did not want to buy from South America. USDA said on Monday exporters had switched a sale of 108,000 tonnes of soybeans to Taiwan to U.S. origin.
